root_causes.description: Flux exceptions indicate significant variances in account balances, likely due to inadequate review processes or missing supporting documentation.
root_causes.financial_impact: $51K in flux exceptions exceed materiality thresholds.

remediations.action: Implement enhanced variance analysis procedures, including automated alerts for significant flux thresholds and mandatory documentation for variances exceeding $10K.
remediations.estimated_effort: 2 weeks for process redesign and training; 1 week for system configuration updates.
remediations.success_criteria: Reduction in flux exceptions by 80% within the next two financial periods.
